name: Authentic AI OS feedback
headline: Tell Billy what worked or what broke
subheadline: Quick feedback on the Authentic AI OS skills. Good or rough, it all helps the system get better.
thanksBody: This goes straight to Billy. Thanks for taking the time, it is how the system improves.

fields.label: Failure mode tag
fields.helpText: Short tag for the kind of break if one is obvious: fabrication, wrong-voice, broken-wikilink, wrong-alignment, missing-input, other.

fields.label: What happened
fields.placeholder: What went wrong, or what worked well.

fields.label: What you wanted instead
fields.placeholder: Optional. What you expected or hoped for.

fields.label: Mode, format, pillar
fields.helpText: Which mode or dial the skill ran in, plus format and pillar where they apply.

fields.label: Reproduction case
fields.helpText: A seeds.json-shaped JSON case reconstructed from the session: the raw input, the persona reveals and withholds, format, mode, distinctive phrases, banks pulled, fabrication traps. Drop into tests/corpus to replay.

fields.label: Fixtures snapshot
fields.helpText: The full content of the determinative vault files the skill read this run, each under a path header. Never include held-out quote files.

fields.label: Bad output verbatim
fields.helpText: The exact thing the skill produced that went wrong, pasted whole. Do not trim or paraphrase.

fields.label: Artifacts touched
fields.helpText: Comma-separated vault paths the skill wrote or was about to write.

fields.label: Your email
fields.helpText: Only if you want Billy to follow up.
